<entry id="P00601">
<head-word>עַיִן</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> עוּן)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>eye, sight, look</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 24
<sup>a</sup> בשן וע', v. יָצָא. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> הכהו על עֵינֹו וכ' if the master struck him on his eye and made it blind. B. Kam. 83
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. XXI, 24) אימא ע' ממש may not the text mean that he who injures a person’s eye must really suffer the same injury? Sabb. 108
<sup>b</sup> bot. יד לע' וכ' an unwashed hand (in the morning) touching the eye deserves to be cut off. Taan. 8
<sup>b</sup> סמוי מן הע', v. סָמָא. Ib. דבר שאין הע' שולטת בו something which the eye cannot look at (being stored away), v. infra; a. v. fr.—[Y. Ned. IX, end, 41
<sup>c</sup> עשה לה ע' של זהב, a corrupt dittography of עשה לה שן של זהב.]—ע' טובה (also יפה) a benevolent eye, 
<italic>good will, liberality</italic>, opp. ע' רעה or עֵין הרע (abbr. עה"ר), also ע' צרה 
<italic>ill-will, selfishness, envy.</italic> Ab. II, 9. Sabb. 74
<sup>a</sup> משום ע' יפה וכ' he intended to show his good will. Tosef. Ḥall. I, 7 שעינו יפה בעיסתו he is liberal with his dough (is glad to give the priest’s portion), opp. עינו צרה. Esth. R. to 1. 4 היתה עינו צרה בממונו he was jealous of his wealth (unwilling to leave it to his heirs to be enjoyed by them). Ab. V, 13 עינו רצה בשל אחרים he is illiberal with regard to other people’s money (begrudges them the privilege of giving charity), ע' רעה בשלו he is illiberal with his own money (is too greedy to afford himself the pleasure of giving charity). Ib. II, 11, v. יֵצֶר; a. fr.—צַר ע' (= רַע ע') 
<italic>selfish</italic>, opp. טוב ע' 
<italic>liberal, selfless</italic>. Sabb. 108
<sup>b</sup> שדורי … צר ע' אנא I send you (the salve), lest you say that I am selfish. Sot. 38
<sup>b</sup> אפי' העופות מכירין בצָרֵי ע' even birds recognize selfish men. Ib. כל הנהנה מצרי ע' וכ' he who accepts benefits from self-seeking men, transgresses a law (ref. to Prov. XXIII, 6). Ib. אין … לטוב ע' the cup of benediction must be handed to none but an unselfish person (with ref. to Prov. XXII, 9); a. e.—Esp. ע' רעה, עֵין הרע (abbrev. עה"ר), or only עַיִן, 
<italic>the evil eye, an envious glance that brings harm to the person looked at, bewitchment</italic>. B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. VII, 15) זו ע' that means the effect of an evil eye. Ib. תשעים … בע' רעה וכ' ninety-nine persons die of an evil eye against one in the natural course. Gen. R. s. 91 שלא תשלוט בכם עה"ר that the evil eye may have no power over you. Ib. לא הייתם … מפני הע' were you not afraid of the evil eye? Ber. 20a ע' שלא … אין עה"ר שולטת בי no evil eye can affect him whose eye refused to feed on what was not his (to look at the charms of a married woman); a. fr.—שקל ע' בע' 
<italic>to balance the scales exactly, to allow no overweight</italic> (v. עוּן, a. כָּרַע). B. Bath. V, 11; a. fr.—בע' 
<italic>visible to the eye, discernible; in natural form</italic>. Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>a</sup> אע"פ ששחוקין בעֵינָן הן although they are ground, they are still discernible. Ib. אם בעַיְינָן הן if they are in their natural form (not mashed); a. fr.—כְּעֵין 
<italic>like the appearance of, similar to, a sort of</italic> (cmp. גַּוָּון). Ib.
<sup>b</sup> כל שהוא כע' סולת וכ' whatever resembles a pudding or dumpling. Ber. 58
<sup>a</sup> (in Chald. dict.) מלכותא דארעא כע' וכ' the government on earth is like the government in heaven (inspires reverence); a. fr.—מֵעֵין 
<italic>a reflection of, of the nature of; an abstract of</italic>. Snh. 105
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to the preposition מ in I Kings I, 47) מע' קאמר ליה he means, ‘as a reflection’ (of thy name, thy throne). Ib. (ref. to Jud. V, 24) מע' קאמר it means ‘similar to’ (the blessings of Sarah &c.). Ber. IV, 3 מע' י"ח an abstract of the eighteen benedictions. Y. ib. 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. שבע מע' י"ח seven benedictions embodying the eighteen. Ib. VI, 10
<sup>b</sup> ברכה אחת מע' שלש one benediction embodying the three. Gen. R. s. 11, a. e., v. דּוּגְמַטְרִין.—
<italic>Du.</italic> עֵינַיִים, עֵינַיִם. Bekh. VII, 4 עֵינָיו גדולות וכ' if his (the priest’s) eyes are as large as those of a calf. Ib. 3. Ber. 58
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. נתן עיניו בו וכ' he put his eyes on him, and he was turned into a heap of bones. Y. Hor. III, end, 48
<sup>c</sup> נתנו עֵינֵיהֶן בשמואל וכ' they directed their attention to Samuel &c.; a. fr.—אחז את הע', v. אָחַז.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>anything resembling the eye, hole, ring</italic> &c. Kel. VIII, 7 ע' של תנור the ‘eye’ of an oven (the fire-place under the oven, Maim.; the opening for the escape of the smoke, which may be closed to retain the heat, R. S.).</definition>
<notes> Ib. IX, 8 תנור שניקב מעינו an oven in the eye of which is a defect. Ib. XXI, 2 ע' 
<italic>the ring-shaped pad</italic> around an animal’s neck (a halter of soft material). Ib. ע' של מתכת a metal 
<italic>hame</italic> (cmp. עוֹנָתָא). Tosef. ib. B. Bath. I, 7 העיין שבמצעד the ring attached to an adze; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>spring, well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. I, 10; a. fr.—[Frequ. עֵין in pr. n. pl., as ע' סוכר, ע' טב; v. respective determinants].</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00602">
<head-word>עַיִן</head-word>
<head-word>עֵינָא</head-word>
<head-word>עַיְינָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>eye, sight</italic> &c. Targ. Lev. XXIV, 20.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 2. Ib. X, 5; a. fr.—Ḥull. 96
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. טביעות ע', v. טְבִיעוּתָא.—בע' (v. preced.) 
<italic>discernible, in natural form</italic>. Pes. 75
<sup>a</sup> top בְּעֵינֵיה, v. קִיּוּהָא.—כְּעֵין, מֵעֵין, v. preced. Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 28. Targ. Josh XXIV, 27; a. e.—ע' בישא (or only ע') 
<italic>evil eye</italic>. Targ. Y. Gen. XLII, 5.—Ber. 20
<sup>a</sup>. Pes. 50
<sup>b</sup> שלטא בהו ע' the eye controls them (they cannot be hidden from sight; v. Taan. 8
<sup>b</sup>, quot. in preced.). B. Mets. 30
<sup>a</sup> משום ע' (Ms. M. ע' בישא) because it attracts the (evil) eye; a. v. fr.—Ned. 50
<sup>a</sup> the 
<pgbrk id="pg1072" />ram (figure-head, v. אֵילָא) דכל ספינתא עבדין ליה מן ע' which all ships have attached (as a protection) from the evil eye (and which the losers paid a high price for redeeming; cmp. Sm. Ant. s. v. Insigne) [comment. explain differently].—
<plural-form>Pl. עֵינִין, עַיְינִין</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. III, 6; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ring, collar; hole</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 10
<sup>a</sup> בת עינא (he cuts out) the hole for the hopper, v. כָּבַשׁ.—
<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Targ. Hos. X, 10, v. עוֹנָתָא</plural-form></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>guide</italic>,] 
<italic>guide-post on cross-roads</italic> (only in 
<italic>pl.</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXXVIII, 14 פרשות ע'; ib. 21 ע' (ed. Berl. עֵינַיִם, as pr. n. pl.; Y. סכות ע').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>spring, well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XVI, 7; a. fr.—Targ. Y. I Ex. XV, 27 ענווא (some ed. עניא, read: עֵינָא or עַיְינָא).—
<plural-form>Pl. עַיְינִין, עֵינָוָון, עֵינָוָן, עֵינְוָתָא; עֵינָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Y. I, II ib. Targ. II Chr. XXXII, 3. Ib. 4 עַיְינָוָתָא. Targ. Y. I Num. XXXIV, 9, sq. (טירת) עֵינְוָותָא pr. n. pl. 
<italic>Ṭ</italic>
<italic>irath ‘Envatha</italic> (h. text חצר עינן); Targ. Y. II ib. (דירת) עַיְינוּתָא, v. עַיְנוּתָא.—Bekh. 55
<sup>a</sup> sq. והאיכא עינתא מידליין but are there not springs higher than the Euphrates?</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00612">
<head-word>עִינּוּי</head-word>
<head-word>עִנּ'</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (עָנָה II) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>delay, postponement.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. V, 8 ע' הדין delay in executing judgment, contrad. to עוות; Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXVIII; Sabb. 33
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>affliction, oppression; suffering</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp. s. 18 (ref. to ענה תענה, Ex. XXII, 22) אחד ע' מרובה וכ' whether a great oppression (effecting a great loss), or a small oppression; Yalk. Ex. 349. Yoma 74
<sup>b</sup> ע' בידי שמים a divine affliction; ע' בידי אדם an affliction at the hands of men. Sifré Deut. 130 (ref. to Deut. XVI, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> it is called ‘bread of misery’ with reference to the affliction which they suffered in Egypt; a. fr.—Esp. (with or without נפש) 
<italic>self-affliction, mortification of the flesh</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma l. c. (ref. to Lev. XVI, 31) ע' שיש בו אבידת נפש an affliction with which a loss of vitality is connected (v. אֲבֵידָה). Ib. (ref. to Deut. VIII, 3) מה להלן ע' רעבון וכ' as there affliction means suffering through lack of food, so here &c. Ib. 77

<sense>

<notes>
<pgbrk id="pg1073" />Erub. 83
<sup>b</sup> כמה עִיסַת המדבר how much is the 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isah</italic> of the desert? Makhsh. II, 8 פת ע' bread made of started dough (of pure flour), opp. פת קיבר. Tosef. Ḥall. I, 4 העושה ע' לאוכלה בבצק if one starts dough with the intention to eat it as dough when it is risen. Y. ib. II, end, 58
<sup>d</sup> דרך ע' the way dough is made (of pure flour). Ib. עִיסָתוֹ מרובה his (the baker’s) dough is a large quantity. Ib. עינה יפה בעִיסָתָהּ, v. עַיִן; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עִיסוֹת</plural-form>. Erub. l. c. (ref. to Num. XV, 20) כדי עִיסוֹתֵיכֶם a quantity large enough for your dough (for immediate use); וכמה עיסותיכם וכ' and how large is that quantity? As much as the 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isa</italic> of the desert. Ab. Zar. 68
<sup>a</sup>. Sot. 30
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>the human body, sensuality</italic>. Lev. R. s. 13, v. נָשַׁף. Ber. 17
<sup>a</sup> גלוי … ומי מעכב שאור שבע' it is revealed and known to thee, that it is our will to do thy will, and what prevents it? The leaven in the dough (the fermenting passion). Gen. R. s. 34 (ref. to Gen. VIII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> עלובה היא הע' שנחתומה וכ' it is poor dough which the baker (that sells it) declares to be bad; a. e.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>a mixed family, a family suspected of containing an alien admixture, ʿisah</italic>, (opp. סולת נקיה, v. 
<xref rid="O01041">סֹלֶת</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>d</sup> top; Tosef. Kidd. V, 2 איזוהי ע' (כשירה) כל וכ' what 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isah</italic> is it the issue of which is admitted to priesthood? In which there is no suspicion of an admixture of 
<italic>n’thinim</italic> &c.; Keth. 14
<sup>a</sup> איזוהי אלמנת ע' (strike out אלמנת, v. Tosaf. a. l.). Tosef. l. c. מפני מה אמרו ע' פסולה וכ' why, then, has it been declared that a woman of an 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isah</italic> family is prohibited from marrying into priesthood? Because suspected  
<italic>ḥălalim</italic> (v. חָלָל II) are mixed up with it. Eduy. VIII, 3, a. fr. אלמנת ע' the widow of one belonging to an 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isah</italic> family. Ib. ע' כשירה לטמא וכ' a member of an 
<italic>ʿ</italic>
<italic>isah</italic> family may serve (through intermarriage) to make clean as well as to make unclean, v. מִקְוֶה; a. fr.—Yalk. Deut. 808 עמדו … וערבו את הע' (not וערכו) the daughters of Lot arose and mixed the dough (had incestuous intercourse).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00680">
<head-word>עֵירוּב</head-word>
<head-word>עֵר'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (עָרַב I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>interweaving, mixture, conjunction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kinn. I, 4 שתי נשים שלקחו … בע' two women that bought their birds for sacrifices in common (not designating which of them belonged to the one and which to the other). Mikv. VI, 7 ע' מקואות in the case of two bathing reservoirs joined (a connection having formed between them); Ḥag. 21
<sup>b</sup>; Yeb. 15
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Pes. III, beg. 29
<sup>d</sup> על עֵירוּבוֹ for eating leavened matter in a mixture, opp. חמץ ברור; Bab. ib. 43
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֶירוּבִין, עֵר'</plural-form>. Y. Orl. II, 61
<sup>d</sup> bot. Y. Bicc. II, 65
<sup>a</sup> top אין הביכורין … עֵירוּבֵיהֶן וכ' first-fruits have no prohibitive effect on mixtures or on what has grown of them as to eating them in Jerusalem. Ib. עֵירוּבֵי בכורים mixtures of first-fruits with common ones; ע' מעשר mixtures of tithes with secular fruit.—עירוב פרשיות 
<italic>an interweaving of biblical sections, clauses of one section taken over, for interpretative purposes, to a succeeding section; misplacement</italic>. B. Kam. 107
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to the clause אשר יאמר … שניהם, Ex. XXII, 8) ע' פ' כתוב כאן וכ' here is a misplacement, and the words 
<italic>Ki hu zeh</italic> (which intimate that an oath can be administered only when the defendant admits a part of the claim) refer to the subject of loans (Ex. l. c. 24 sq.). Snh. 2
<sup>b</sup> אי קסבר ע' פ' … ליבעי נמי מומחין if he adopts the opinion that here is a misplaced clause (and 
<italic>ki hu zeh</italic> refers to loans), let him also require authorized, learned judges (אלהים)!</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>‘Erub, a symbolical act by which the legal fiction of community</italic> or 
<italic>continuity is established</italic>, e.g. 
<italic>a</italic>) with ref. to Sabbath limits (תחומין): a person deposits, before the Sabbath (or the Holy Day), certain eatables to remain in their place over the next day, by which act he transfers his abode to that place, and his movements on the Sabbath are measured from it as the centre; 
<italic>b</italic>) with ref. to buildings with a common court (חצירות): the inmates contribute their share towards a dish which is deposited in one of the dwellings, by which act all the dwellings are considered as common to all (one רָשׁוּת), and the carrying of objects on the Sabbath from one to the other and across the court is permitted; 
<italic>c</italic>) with ref. to preparing meals (תבשילין) for the Sabbath on a Holy Day occurring on a Friday: a person prepares a dish on Thursday and lets it lie over until the end of the Sabbath, by which fiction all the cooking for the Sabbath which he does on the Holy Day (Friday) is merely a continuation 
<pgbrk id="pg1076" />of the preparation begun on Thursday.</definition>
<notes> Erub. III, 2 השולח עֵרוּבוֹ … ביד מי שאינו מודה בע' if a person sends his ‘Erub (the eatables to be deposited) through a deaf mute or through one who does not believe in the Erub (e.g. a Samaritan), אינו ע' it is not a legal ‘Erub. Ib. 3 אין ערובו ע' his Erub is not legal. Ib. 5 מתנה אדם על ערובו … עֵרוּבִי וכ' a person may make his Sabbath centre conditional (by laying two ‘Erubs on two opposite points) and say, if gentile troops should invade from the east, my Sabbath centre shall be on the western side &c. Ib. VI, 10 נתנו עֵרוּבָן במקום וכ' if the inmates of a court placed their ‘Erub (common dish) at a certain place, but one, of the inner or of the outer court, had forgotten to contribute his share. Ib. VII, 9 בתחלת ע' when the common dish is in its original state; בשירי ע' when there are merely remnants left over. Bets. 15
<sup>b</sup> מי שהיה לו להניח ערובו וכ' he who had the means to prepare and leave a dish on Thursday and does not do it; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Erub. 21
<sup>b</sup> בשעה שהתקין שלמה ע' when Solomon introduced the ‘Erub. Ib. VII, 11 עֵרוּבֵי תחומין ‘Erubs for the purpose of regulating Sabbath limits; ע' חצירות for the purpose of regulating the Sabbath movements of inmates of common courts. Yoma 28
<sup>b</sup> קיים … אפי' עירובי תבשילין Abraham observed even the regulations concerning preparations for the Sabbath on a Holy Day preceding it. Bets. l. c. מי שלא היה לו להניח ע' תבשילין he who had not the means to prepare a dish on Thursday &c. (v. supra). Gen. R. s. 49 אפי' הילכות עירובי חצירות וכ' Abraham knew even the laws regulating Sabbath movements among inmates of a court by means of ‘Erub; a. fr.—
<italic>‘Erubin</italic>, name of a treatise, of the Order of Moʿed, of the Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P00712">
<head-word>עָכַב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. עָקַב) 
<italic>to be curved; hooked</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִיכֵּב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to detain, prevent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 ואל תְּעַכֵּב את גאולתנו and delay not our redemption. Ber. 7
<sup>a</sup> ומי מְעַכֵּב, v. עִיסָה; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to invalidate an act by an omission; to be indispensable</italic> (v. עִיכּוּב). Zeb. V, 1 מתנה אחת מהן מְעַכֶּבֶת the omission of one of these manipulations (v. מַתָּנָה) makes the whole act illegal. Ib. אם לא נתן לא ע' if he did not pour the blood into the 
<italic>y’sod</italic> (יְסוֹד), it does not invalidate the act. Ib. 48
<sup>a</sup> לעַכֵּב מנין whence do we prove that it is indispensable? (opp. למצוה). Men. IV, 1 התכלת אינה מעכבת את הלבן the absence of the blue thread in the show fringes does not hinder the white thread, i.e. in the absence of the one, the other may do for the ceremony. Ib. הסולת והשמן אינם מְעַכְּבִין … ולא היין מְעַכְּבָן the flour and oil (of the Minḥah) are no hinderance to offering the wine, nor does the wine form a hinderance to them, i.e. the order in which they are offered is immaterial. Ib. המתנות … אינן מְעַכְּבוֹת זו את זו the sprinklings upon the outer altar are no hinderance to one another, i.e. one of them is enough to make the ceremony legal. Ber. 2
<sup>a</sup> ביאת שמשו מְעַכַּבְתּוֹ מלאכול וכ' the sunset of his last day of levitical uncleanness is indispensable for allowing him to eat T’rumah, but the offering of his sacrifice is not; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מְעוּכָּב; f. מְעוּכֶּבֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּכָּבִים, מְעוּכָּבִין; מְעוּכָּבוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Sot. II, beg. 17
<sup>d</sup> ומכיון שהוא מע' מלשמוח וכ' since he is prevented from rejoicing with her (at the sacrifice), it is as if he prevented her from partaking of the sacrifice (by failing to provide for her offering of sanctification). Ib. והוא מעכב מלשמוח (read מְעוּכָּב). Mekh. l. c. כי בגללך אנו מע' for we are detained on thy account; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to detain one’s self; to tarry; to wait for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 3 סבור אתה שהיה משה מעכב וכ' do you think that Moses hesitated (was unwilling) to go? Gen. R. s. 55 על מנת שנאמר לך … ולא תְעַכֵּב even if I tell thee to sacrifice thy son to me, thou wilt not hesitate. Ib. ולא יְעַכֵּב he will not hesitate. Ib. הלואי … ולא אֲעַכֵּב O! that the Lord would appear to me and tell me that I should cut off one of my limbs! I would not hesitate. Tanḥ. Ekeb 6 השכינה מעכבת ישראל וענני כבוד מְעַכְּבִין לך the Divine Presence is waiting, Israel and the clouds of glory are waiting for thee; ib. B’shall. 2; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעַכֵּב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְעַכִּב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be prevented; to be delayed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. VI, 33
<sup>b</sup> bot. מִתְעַכֵּב מן המצות he is precluded from religious acts. Koh. R. to II, 2 מה טיבו שבני מתעכב what is the cause of my son’s tarrying? Num. R. s. 14 נ' לה הענן the cloud of glory tarried for her (Miriam’s) sake; Sot. I, 9 נִתְעַכְּבוּ לה ישראל וכ' Israel tarried for her sake seven days; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00749">
<head-word>עָכַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to stir up, disturb; to trouble, make turbid; to sadden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 5
<sup>a</sup> כל אדם … עוֹכַרְתּוֹ if a man has swelling of wind (haughtiness) in him, the slightest breeze will trouble him (the slightest adversity will upset him); מה ים … עוכרתו וכ' if the sea … is stirred up by the slightest breeze &c. Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>b</sup> bot. לעוֹכֵר את העין וכ' (not לעובר) like one troubling the eye, which becomes clear again. Ber. 25
<sup>b</sup> עוֹכְרָן ברגלו he must stir them up with his foot. Gen. R. s. 80, end (ref. to עכרתם, Gen. XXXIV, 30) צלולה היתה החבית ועֲכַרְתֶּם אותה the wine in the cask was clear, and you have troubled it; Yalk. ib. 135 ועֲכַרְתּוּהָ. Nidd. 20
<sup>a</sup> צללו חוזר ועוכרן if the mixture became clear (the earth settled), he must stir it again; a. fr.—Part. pass. עָכוּר; f. עֲכוּרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. עֲכוּרִים, עֲכוּרִין; עֲכוּרוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. אין … צלולין אלא ע' you must not examine the mixture when it is clear, but when it is turbid; Tosef. ib. III, 11. Gen. R. l. c. ע' היתה … וצללנו אותה the wine was turbid, and we cleared it (we redeemed our honor). Snh. 44
<sup>b</sup>; Lev. R. s. 9 (ref. to Josh. VII, 25) היום הזה אתה ע' ואי אתה ע' וכ' thou art troubled (punished) this day, but thou shalt not be troubled in the hereafter. Sifré Deut. 48 שתה ממים של בוראך … מים ע' וכ' drink of the water of thy Creator’s well, and drink not muddy water, nor be attracted by the words of the heretics; Yalk. Prov. 937; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 22 (ref. to Job XVI, 17) וכי יש תפלה ע' is there also a turbid prayer? Ib. מנין … שתפלתו ע' where is it intimated that the prayer of him in whose hand is robbery, is turbid (rejected)?</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶעְכָּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be stirred up; to become turbid, dreggy, foul</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 9
<sup>a</sup> דם נ' ונעשה חלב the blood (of a pregnant animal) is disturbed (decomposed), and turns into milk. Y. Sot. IV, 19
<sup>c</sup> bot. אין החלב נ' וכ' the milk (of a nursing woman) becomes turbid only after three months (after conception). Y. Nidd. II, end, 50
<sup>b</sup> יצללו ולא יֵעָכְרוּ the water mixed with earth must settle and not be stirred up again; a. fr.—Men. IX, 5 (90
<sup>a</sup>) הלח נ' היבש אינו נ' (Bab. ed. נעקר; Ms. M. נעבר, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) liquid emptied from a large measure into a smaller one is stirred up (and what remains in the large measure partakes of the sacred character of the liquid in the smaller, sacred vessels), whereas dry objects are not stirred up.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P00790">
<head-word>עלי</head-word>
<head-word>עָלָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to go up, rise; to come up, arrive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. VIII, 3 מי שיַּעֲלֶה מכם וכ' whichever of you shall first arrive at Jerusalem (for the Passover), v. infra. Snh. X, 3 אינה עתידה לַעֲלוֹת shall not rise (from the grave at the time of resurrection). Y. Peah V, end, 19
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to גבול עולם, Prov. XXII, 28) זו עוֹלֵי מצרים this refers to those who came up from Egypt; Hag. 3
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. עולי בבל those who came back from Babylonia. Ber. 20
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. (ref. to Gen. XLIX, 22) א"ת עֲלֵי עין אלא עוֹלֵי עין read not 
<italic>‘ăle ‘ayin</italic>, but 
<italic>‘ole ‘ayin</italic>, those rising above the (evil) eye (whom the evil eye cannot affect). Snh. 111
<sup>a</sup> כשע' משה למרום when Moses came up to heaven. Keth. 61
<sup>a</sup> עוֹלָה עמו וכ' she rises with him, but does not go down with him, i.e. the wife rises to the husband’s social position and can claim its comforts, if it be a higher one than her own, &c.; a. v. fr.—Ḥull. 17
<sup>b</sup> עוֹלֶה ויורד בסכין a going up and down in a slaughtering knife, i.e. a curved blade.—קרבן עולה ויורד, v. יָרַד.—עלה על דעת, v. דַּעַת.—Esp. 
<italic>to be put on the altar, be offered</italic>. Zeb. IX, 1 אם עָלְתָה לא תרד if it has been offered, it must not be taken down again. Ib. 2. Men. 22
<sup>b</sup> מכאן לעוֹלִין שאינן מבטלין וכ' this proves that things which are offered up (e.g. blood of several sacrifices that has become mixed up) do not neutralize one another. Ib. 23
<sup>a</sup> חיבורי עולין that which is attached to things which go on the altar; a. fr.—Idiomatic uses: 
<italic>a</italic>) (sub. לחשבון) 
<italic>to be counted in; to be accounted as</italic>. M. Kat. III, 5 שבת עולה ואינה וכ' the Sabbath counts as one of the seven days of mourning, and does not discontinue the mourning, i.e. the mourning continues after the Sabbath; רגלים מפסיקין ואינן עולין festivals discontinue (the mourning begun before), but do not count, i.e. if the burial took place on a festive day, the mourning days begin after the festival. Ab. IV, 13 עוֹלָה זדון, v. זָדוֹן. Zeb. I, 3 לא עָלוּ לבעלים משום חובה the owners of the sacrifices are not credited with them as a compliance with their obligation; a. fr.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>to rise in value; to be esteemed</italic>. Ab. l. c. וכתר שם טוב עוֹלֶה על גביהן the crown of a good name is worth more than all of them; a. e.—
<italic>c</italic>) [
<italic>to rise on the scale, be outweighed</italic>,] 
<italic>to be void, be neutralized</italic> (cmp. בָּטֵל). Ter. IV, 7 תרומה עולה באחד ומאה T’rumah (mixed up in secular matter) is neutralized in one hundred and one (i.e. one against one hundred). Ib. 11 תַּעֲלֶה באחד ומאה is neutralized in &c.; לא תעלה is not neutralized. Ib. 13; a. fr.—
<italic>d</italic>) ע' לרגל, or ע' 
<italic>to go up</italic> (to Jerusalem and the Temple) 
<italic>for the festival</italic>. Yoma 21 בשעה שישראל עולין לרגל when the Israelites were in the Temple on the festivals. Ḥag. I, 1. Ib. 4
<sup>a</sup> שאינן ראויין לעלות who are not fit for the pilgrimage. Pes. 8
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. עוֹלֵי רגלים pilgrims; a. fr.—
<italic>e</italic>) ע' בידו 
<italic>to obtain, achieve</italic>. Ber. 35
<sup>b</sup> עָלְתָה בידן they were successful. Naz. 23
<sup>a</sup> מי שנתכוון לעלות בידו בשר חזיר וע' בידו בשר טלה he who intended to obtain flesh of the swine, and happened to obtain mutton; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִילָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to elevate, exalt, praise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> יהודה שעי' יִתְעַלֶּה Judah who elevated (praised the Roman government), shall be elevated (to high office). Y. Snh. X, 29
<sup>c</sup> top שעִילּוּ אותי וכ' who exalted me &c., v. זָבַח. Gen. R. s. 15 (ref. to וישם, Gen. II, 8) עי' אותו God raised him (made him a dignitary, by analogy to Deut. XVII, 15); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prize, to acquire at the highest price, bid for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 16 (ref. to ויקח, Gen. II, 15) עי' אותו he acquired him (by analogy to Is. XIV, 2; v. infra 
<italic>Hithpa.</italic>); Yalk. ib. 22. Gen. R. s. 40 (ref. to ויעלו, Jer. XXXVIII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> מְעַלִּין אותו (or מַעֲלִין, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) they bade for him.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱלָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to raise, bring up.</italic></definition>
<notes> Makhsh. VI, 1 המַעֲלֶה פירותיו וכ' if one carries his fruits up to the roof, v. כְּנִימָה; Tosef. ib. III, 1. Pesik. R. s. 26 ובקושי הֶעֱלוּהוּ and with hard work they brought him up (out of the pit); a. v. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to offer on the altar</italic>. Zeb. XIV, 3 המַעֲלֶה מבשר וכ' he who offers parts of the flesh of a sin offering &c. Ib. XIII, 1 שחט בפנים וה' בחוץ if he slaughtered a sacrifice within the Temple precincts, and offered it without; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to raise, promote to a higher dignity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 20
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מַעֲלִין בקדש ולא מורידין we may promote (a person or thing) to a higher grade of sanctity, but must not degrade. Tosef. Ned. VI, 5 שמעלה … מטומאתן which raises (relieves) the unclean from their uncleanness; Ned. 75
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. X, 42
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—לא מעלה ולא מוריד, v. יָרַד.—Idiomatic uses: 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>to cause to go up from the reader’s place</italic> (which was low, v. תֵּיבה); 
<italic>to remove, discharge</italic>. Ber. 29
<sup>a</sup> ולא הָעֱלוּהוּ 
<pgbrk id="pg1082" />and they did not remove him. Ib. טעה … מעלין אותו if a reader makes a mistake in the twelfth section of the T’fillah (v. מִין III), he must be removed; a. fr.—
<italic>b</italic>) (v. Kal, c) 
<italic>to neutralize.</italic> Ter. IV, 8 תאנים שחורות מַעֲלוֹת וכ' black figs help to neutralize in conjunction with white ones, i.e. the black and the white secular figs are counted together against the admixture of figs of T’rumah whether black or white; a. fr.—
<italic>c</italic>) (v. Kal, a) 
<italic>to account, credit</italic> or 
<italic>charge</italic>. B. Mets. 69
<sup>b</sup> אני אעלה לך סלע וכ' I will give thee credit for one Sela each month (as a compensation for the use of the cow). Ab. II, 2 מעלה אני עליכם וכ' I (the Lord) shall credit you with a large reward, just as if you had accomplished (the good you had intended to do). Ib. III, 7, sq. מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו וכ' the Bible text (the Lord) charges him as if he had endangered his life (v. חוּב). Yoma 81
<sup>b</sup> מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו וכ' it is accounted to his credit, as if he had fasted on the ninth and the tenth; a. fr.—
<italic>d</italic>) (v. Kal, e) 
<italic>to succeed, profit</italic>. Snh. 90
<sup>b</sup> הֶעֱלֵיתֶם בידכם, v. יָעַל.—
<italic>f</italic>) ה' חן
